page: OVHcloud r3-512 is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.3 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided by a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU and memory performance. The instance achieved a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 194535.72 and a Passmark CPU score of 94314.31, both placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with cached small-block read speeds reaching 8439.52 GB/sec and large-block read speeds at 296.1 GB/sec. In database and key-value store benchmarks, the r3-512 processed 134.58 million Redis SET operations per second, ranking in the top 10%, and scored 31390.6 on Passmark database operations.

Given the high memory density and dedicated CPU resources, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, and multi-threaded processing tasks such as software compilation, which scored 72139.0 in Geekbench Clang tests. The inclusion of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and local NVMe storage provides a balanced resource profile for enterprise databases and caching layers. The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is characterized by its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated resource allocation, which minimizes performance degradation in production environments.
